test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

My parents have promised that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.

options.text: I have been promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.
I am promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.
I am being promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.
I have promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****I have been promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** passive voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + have + past tense + Object (Active voice) + adjunct
 
• **Subject (objective case) + have been + past participle + Object (subjective case) (Passive voice) + adjunct**
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *I have taken him out. (Active voice)*
 
• *He has been taken out by me. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject **of the given sentence is ‘my parents’.
 
• The object of the given subject is ‘I’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **have promised** will be changed to **have been promised**.
 
• **Adjunct **is a word or phrase that constitutes an optional element or is considered of secondary importance in a sentence
 
 
• In the given sentence, *if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US *is the **adjunct. **
 
 

Correct sentence - I have been promised by my parents that if I do well in my school exams, they’ll send me to the US.
